result.document_summary: A May 22, 2025 Hudson County View news article reporting that the Jersey City Council unanimously (9-0) approved an ordinance banning rent-setting algorithms such as RealPage, along with a separate laborer-benefits measure.
result.notes: Secondary news source: it does not give the ordinance number, a codified citation, an effective date, or full coverage and exemption text. The article mentions a $2,000 daily fine (raised by a commenter), that realtors/real estate agents were excluded at the sponsor's accommodation, and that owners using algorithms without colluding were discussed as outside the ordinance's reach; none of this is verified against ordinance text. The cited ordinance name is inferred from the article's description. The laborer wage and benefits measure is out of scope and ignored.

rules.title: Jersey City ban on rent-setting algorithms (RealPage-type software)
rules.requirement: The City Council passed an ordinance banning the use of rent-setting algorithms such as RealPage; RealPage's statement describes it as banning use of certain nonpublic data in revenue management software. Per the article, realtors were excluded at the sponsor's accommodation.
rules.key_value: Ban on rent-setting algorithms; $2,000 daily fine mentioned by a commenter (unverified)
rules.citation: Jersey City rent-setting algorithm ordinance (approved by City Council May 21, 2025)
rules.quoted_span: The Jersey City Council unanimously approved (9-0) a measure banning rent-setting algorithms such as RealPage
rules.coverage_text: The article does not state detailed coverage; it describes a ban on landlords' use of rent-setting algorithms such as RealPage.
rules.exemptions_text: Per the article, real estate agents/realtors were excluded from the ordinance at the sponsor's accommodation; the article does not give the full exemption text.
rules.interaction: A speaker notes the U.S. House of Representatives is considering banning municipalities from such actions, which could affect the ordinance; the article names no other law.
